name: In'yoku Kyoudai
source:
Sister is on top as usual. She moans too loudly. Parents are in bad relations and live separately, but it's still a confusing situation if neighbors are taken in account. So, sister, please keep your voice down.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
姐姐像往常一样骑在上面。她的呻吟声太大了。父母关系不和，且已经分居；但如果把邻居也算在内，情况依旧十分尴尬。所以，姐姐，请你小声一点。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
